[[File:recycling Station Small Image.png|thumb|A Level 4 Recycling Station that is yet to be collected]]

{{Quote|The Recycling Station will regularly fill up with resources. Approach a full Recycling Station to raise its material cache. Interact with it to collect all recycled resources.|Tutorial}}

'''Recycling Station''' is a [[Facility (Regional Development)|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

The stations produce {{I|Aerospace Material I|g=0}} and {{I|Aerospace Material II|g=0}} which are necessary materials for [[Dijiang]] and have a cooldown in-between collections. Only a limited amount of Aerospace Materials are required to complete all upgrades on Dijiang.

[[Depot Node]] Deliveries have Recycling Stations in their list of potential recipients.
